【原视频简介】
I found the perfect place to start my Minecraft Hardcore world: a mountain valley where I could build something worth surviving for.

Starting with nothing, I explore villages, hunt for diamonds, survive some close calls underground, and build my first mountain home. Along the way, this world starts becoming more than just another survival run.

This isn’t a speedrun. I’m building a world I want to keep coming back to one very questionable decision at a time.

🐺 NAME MY DOG!
Leave your name suggestion in the comments and like your favorite. The top comment wins!

Seed: 28499671

Subscribe to follow the world as it grows. Next episode, we’re heading into the Nether.

#Minecraft #MinecraftHardcore #MinecraftSurvival
